#ifdef MSAA
Texture2DMS<uint2> Stencil : register(t0);
uint LoadS(int2 p) { p = clamp(p, int2(0,0), int2(rtSize) - 1); return Stencil.Load(p, 0).g; }
Texture2D<uint2> Stencil : register(t0);
uint LoadS(int2 p) { p = clamp(p, int2(0,0), int2(rtSize) - 1); return Stencil.Load(int3(p, 0)).g; }
#endif
// enemy family bit (modes 3/5) and not the first-person mask; bit 3 marks a VISIBLE pixel of a mode-3 mesh
float Mask(int2 p) { uint s = LoadS(p); if (s & 0x20u) return 0.0; if (!(s & 0x04u)) return 0.0; if (throughWalls < 0.5 && !(s & 0x08u)) return 0.0; return 1.0; }
struct VSOut { float4 pos : SV_Position; float2 uv : TEXCOORD0; };
VSOut VS(uint id : SV_VertexID) { VSOut o; float2 uv = float2((id << 1) & 2, id & 2); o.pos = float4(uv * float2(2, -2) + float2(-1, 1), 0, 1); o.uv = uv; return o; }
float4 PS(VSOut i) : SV_Target {
    int2 p = int2(i.uv * rtSize);
    if (debugView > 0.5) { uint s = LoadS(p); float3 bits = float3((s & 0x04u) ? 1 : 0, (s & 0x08u) ? 1 : 0, (s & 0x20u) ? 1 : 0); return float4(bits, any(bits) ? 0.6 : 0.0); }
    float c = Mask(p);
    if (c > 0.5) return float4(color.rgb, fill);
    // nearest-enemy-pixel falloff: the first (innermost) ring with ANY hit sets the strength, so a tiny far-away
    // silhouette still gets a full halo (a 4-hit threshold made distant enemies vanish)
    const int RINGS = 6, TAPS = 16;
    float glow = 0.0;
    [unroll] for (int k = 1; k <= RINGS; k++) {
        float r = max(1.0, radius * k / RINGS);
        float fall = pow(saturate(1.0 - (k - 1.0) / RINGS), soft);
        float hit = 0.0;
        [unroll] for (int t = 0; t < TAPS; t++) {
            float a = t * 6.2831853 / TAPS + k * 0.2;   // rotate rings so taps interleave
            hit += Mask(p + int2(round(float2(cos(a), sin(a)) * r)));
        }
        glow = max(glow, saturate(hit) * fall);
    return float4(color.rgb, glow * strength);
